Name: Pathos Shrine
Author: deleted140694053
Description:
This mod simply edits the alter in Pierre's shop to have a pufferfish instead of a Yoba symbol. Also changed the dialogue you get when clicking on it.

Might not be compatible with other mods that change town interiors.

Doesn't change other references or dialogue involving Yoba.

Credit to Pathos for the beautiful, perfect, stunning, amazing, spectacular, wonderful, fantastic, jaw-dropping, insert more positive adjectives here, pufferchick.

Manifest.Description: Changes the shrine of yoba to have the pufferchick on it, and changes all vanilla dialouge referecning Yoba to reference Pathos now.
